parameters.name: method
parameters.label: Method
parameters.description: Curve evaluation method. NURBS for smooth splines, Bezier for predictable interpolation.

parameters.name: order
parameters.label: Order
parameters.description: Spline order (2=linear, 3=quadratic, 4=cubic). Higher = smoother but more oscillation risk.

parameters.name: closed
parameters.label: Closed
parameters.description: Connect last control point back to first.

parameters.name: divisions
parameters.label: Divisions
parameters.description: Number of evaluated points along the curve.

parameters.name: controlpoints
parameters.label: Control Points
parameters.description: Number of control points defining the curve.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.label: Weight
parameters.description: Global weight multiplier for NURBS control points.

parameters.name: tension
parameters.label: Tension
parameters.description: Tension modifier — negative pulls curve toward control points, positive pushes away.

troubleshooting.solution: Check Weight and Tension values — try Weight=1, Tension=0.

description: GPU-accelerated NURBS/Bezier curve generator. Evaluates curves from control points on the GPU with configurable order, tension, and weight. Supports open or closed curves for motion paths and parametric shapes.
